coin.specsText:
Silver coin Aerial Cableway Klein Matterhorn The silver coin “Aerial Cableway Klein Matterhorn” is the first coin in the trilogy on the theme of “Swiss aerial cableways”. It honors a major Zermatt project that will be completed by the summer of 2023: with the continuous, year-round connection between Zermatt and Cervinia (Italy) thanks the Matterhorn Alpine Crossing, a long-cherished vision will become reality after more than 80 years.
